replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
I'd be happy to do the YAML.

Regarding the map its self, I would personally remove the Quintus styled chest, due to the fact that it doesn't suit the map, because there is limited PvP space. Consider expanding the lanes, and add some more, smaller, islands between the main one and the lanes, this would create more options in terms of attacking. This would increase the amount of space in general.
